item.description:
Kento Alpha 0.9.27, build 2759

Trainer's panel

  • Trainer has its own panel. Frames shows the frames you fixed as pictures along a strip, the held-out one edged dashed; click one to go to it, or its x to take it off. Add current frame is lit while the frame isn't a training frame yet.
  • Suggest frames shows the frames to fix next as dimmed pictures with their reason, as hollow marks on the Timeline, and as circles over the bars of where the pass is unsure.
  • quality is Quick, Full or Custom side by side, with how long a pass should take on this Mac under it.
  • Run draws the loss as it falls, with the held-out frame's FLIP as a dot every 1,000 steps.
  • Passes lists every pass with its steps, minutes, FLIP and flicker; a pass whose frames changed since it trained is marked. A row's menu has Use this pass, Show its folder and Delete pass.
  • Evaluate shows the held-out frame four ways (the plate, your fix, the pass and their difference), each measure in words, and a bar for each frame where the pass is unsure; click one to go to that frame.
  • The job is in the panel's header too, beside the name.

Pen test

  • Help > Pen test... shows what your pen sends Kento as you draw on its pad: whether it arrives as a pen or only as a mouse, the pressure now and the range you reach, tilt, and how many events a second. It says in plain words whether pressure is reaching Kento, and if not, what to change in the tablet's own settings.
  • It also shows what Paint's brush and RotoPaint's brush make of that pressure: the size and opacity range they'll paint with.
  • Save trace keeps what the pen sent, to attach to a problem report.

Paint

  • The stroke under the pen, onion skin and split compare are drawn through the Viewer's own display, view, look, exposure and gamma, so nothing changes color as the pen lifts.
  • More strokes paint on the fast canvas: add, multiply, max and min with a see-through color, smear with a Photoshop brush's tip, and a reveal with nothing in bg. Only AI fill still paints the slower way.
  • A Photoshop brush's tip after a dust or pigment stroke now paints with its tip, not round.

Fixes

  • The Viewer no longer goes black when footage dropped into a fresh comp is shown in it. (Until now, resizing the window brought the picture back.)
  • A Read's file type shows the type it read the file as (jpeg, exr...), where it was empty.
  • .ko files have a document icon of their own, a page with Kento's mark, and open in Kento.
  • A panel in the Properties bin grows when its content does after it opens, so its last rows no longer fall out of sight.
  • A slider for a whole number (a count of frames) runs evenly from end to end.

Kento Alpha 0.9.26, build 2741

Trainer

  • Evaluate says how a pass does: on the frames held out, how close it looks to your fix (FLIP and PSNR); how much it changes outside the mask; and whether it adds flicker from frame to frame.
  • Suggest frames names the frames to fix next: the ones least like those you've fixed, and where the pass is unsure of itself.
  • Context frames work: with 1 each side the network sees the frame before and after too, for fixes that depend on motion.
  • Steady holds a fix still that wavers from frame to frame, averaging its change over the frames either side; the plate's own motion is left as it is.
  • Each pass holds out a different frame to judge it, so every frame you fixed judges some pass.
  • The comp keeps the active pass's network too, so a comp copied without its passes folder still renders.

Paint

  • A clone from Paint's own output on another frame now paints on the fast canvas too: every tool and source does, but an AI fill still.
  • In paint-only output, a clone from the node's own output reads the painted picture, not the paint-only one.

Kento Alpha 0.9.25, build 2724

Paint

  • Photoshop brushes: Import Photoshop brushes..., at the foot of Paint's presets, adds a Photoshop brush file's (.abr) brushes to yours as a set of their own. The menu at the top of the presets switches sets. Each brush keeps its size, roundness, angle and spacing; a brush drawn from a picture (spatter, chalk, a leaf) paints with that picture as its tip, scaled and turned with the brush. A comp keeps the tips it uses, so it renders anywhere.
  • The brush editor shows a Photoshop brush's tip under Shape; Use a round tip goes back to the round dab.
  • Grain-aware strokes, and auto grade while it's still measuring, now paint on the fast canvas too, drawn as you paint; the auto grade card still shows what it measured.

Trainer

  • A pass renders without PyTorch: each pass is saved as an ONNX file too, and a frame that isn't written yet is worked out by Kento itself once ONNX Runtime is installed (Install ONNX Runtime, under the pass). Render nodes can use a pass as it is.

Render nodes

  • A Linux render node to install: Kento's render node for Linux (x86_64) as a package of its own, unpacked and started with one command. Tried on a studio Linux box against the studio's storage: a real shot's frames match a Mac's.
